title: palace in your bedroom
author: Shanzikull
alt: an abstract composition with a poem in the left. to the center right is a chair in a brightly overexposed space, with a bit of tree/dirt terrain poking out from the bottom right. the poem itself reads 'overbearing sunlight floods these chambers such - regal cloak amalgams thy silhouette in flux - regent of nowhere at all - ever tightening crown - a palace in your bedroom - scepters sprouting through - sovereign shoulders you - its throne cold ground - horizontally perfect posture - derelict decrees - spread digit pleas - god i am suffocating here - lo a galvanizing echo - law adhering carrion - a solemn march departing - realms outside thy binding - their rites ignite your coffin - in spontaneous conflagration - and it feels as though you're waking - eyes wide open - feet meet grass - farewell goes unspoken - and a carpet marks your path'
description: inspired by a synth demo from raine
